newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares major disaster in Minnesota.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares major disaster in Minnesota.

text.p: President Clinton Tuesday declared a major disaster in Minnesota and ordered federal aid for the areas struck by severe flooding, winter storms, snowmelt, high winds, rain and ice.
Clinton's action would make federal funding available in 21 counties, the White House said in a written statement.
Assistance includes grants, low-income loans and other programs to help individuals and business owners recover from the effects of almost three weeks of severe weather.
